CVEAPI_URL.title: CVEAPI_URL
CVEAPI_URL.description: URL of the CVE API, defaults to https://cve.openkat.dev/v1

CONNECT_TIMEOUT.title: CONNECT_TIMEOUT
CONNECT_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout in seconds for establishing a connection to the CVE API. Defaults to 10.

READ_TIMEOUT.title: READ_TIMEOUT
READ_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout in seconds between bytes received from the CVE API. Defaults to 30.
